library(tidyverse)

Experiment

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot() + theme(plot.background = element_rect(linetype = "dotted", color = "black", linewidth = .2))

library(patchwork)
(p + p) / (p + p) / (p + p) / (p + p) / (p + p) 

last_plot() +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), units = "cm")))

ggsave("physical.png", width = 7, height = 10)

ggsave("physical1.png",plot = p, width = 7, height = 10)


# pretty close!

options(scipen = 10)

library(gapminder)
library(tidyverse)

gm <- gapminder::gapminder

{gm |> filter(year == 1952) |>
  ggplot() + 
  aes(y = lifeExp) + 
  aes(x = gdpPercap) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_blank(data = gm) + 
  geom_point(alpha = .5) + 
  aes(size = pop) +
  scale_size(limits = c(0, 800000000), range = c(1,20)) +
  aes(color = country) + guides(color = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
  filter(gm, year == 1957) + 
  filter(gm, year == 1962) + 
  filter(gm, year == 1967) + 
  filter(gm, year == 1972) + 
  filter(gm, year == 1977) + 
  filter(gm, year == 1982) + 
  filter(gm, year == 1987) + 
  filter(gm, year == 1992) + 
  filter(gm, year == 1997) } |> 
  codehover::ch_hover()
